lines.text: Meanwhile the beetle carries his own grammar:
the aggregation pheromone, the come-hither he emits
to call his kind to the feast and the bed at once.
And the flower's bouquet braids into that signal,
crosses the wires of food and sex and gathering,
so the bowl smells like party, like pantry, like pairing —
a superstimulus, a key cut larger than the lock,
the supernormal egg the gull will brood before her own.
